description: Harness battery: multi-level dogfood + self-improvement findings. Wave 4 default seat is Sol high (see freeze.wave4). Diagnose-plan tasks remain mutation-forbidden; self-improve tasks may verified-edit when seated model allows.

tasks.brief: WAVE 4+ HARNESS DOGFOOD (multi-level) + SELF-IMPROVEMENT FINDINGS. ARCHITECT DIAGNOSE ONLY — no product mutations. HARD RULES: (1) No applyEdit/writeFile/createBackup/restoreBackup. (2) Tools: readFile, search, searchCode, searchDocs, listDir, gitStatus, gitLog, gitDiff, typeCheck, runBuild, runTests, runFocusedTests, runLint, lsp, astValidate, importGuard, executeSkill. (3) LOAD SKILLS EARLY: executeSkill {"name":"comorbidity-check"} then executeSkill {"name":"systematic-debugging"}. (4) ALREADY SHIPPED (do not re-open without new HEAD evidence): SelfImproveCompoundLoop feed-forward, withLearnedGuidance, receipts/*-plan.md, tip/spend ledger, host-identity canonicalizeHost. (5) MULTI-LEVEL AUDIT (observed>inferred>guessed, cite paths): MAKE (gen empty-artifact / domain gates), SEE (eval/vision honesty), TALK (chat/studio DX), FIX SYSTEM (harness tools/compound/operator paths), COMPOUND (adaptation inject consumers). Prefer compounding product fixes over laundry lists. (6) If ## Learned from prior runs is present, CITE [adaptation:id] and build on it. (7) complete(params.plan)≥200: BLUF; multi-level findings; comorbidity; systematic root causes; ranked P0–P3 Interwave backlog with owner/acceptance/blast/rollback; SELF-IMPROVEMENT FINDINGS section; re-verify protocol. No implement. ANTI-GOAL: scoreboard theater; beauty unpark; dirty WIP as mutation targets; instrument-only essays.

COMPOUND REQUEUE DOGFOOD (not MECE single-shot). ARCHITECT DIAGNOSE ONLY — no product mutations. This seat is attempt 2 of a recursive improvement path: assume attempt 1 failed with a retryable provider-timeout or similar and left prior envelope guidance. Deliver complete(params.plan)≥200 focused on ONE residual that compounds from prior failure (timeout taxonomy, continuity proof, or publisher discipline) — not a full-system laundry list. HARD: no applyEdit/writeFile. Prefer short BLUF + max 3 P0 residuals with acceptance.

W1-H2 REQUEUE: Sol failed this self-improve (no verified-edit, tierStoppedAt=1). Product target: bounded packet shaping so focus files and verification targets stay aligned. Preferred surfaces: src/harness/agent/LLMModeAgent.ts (packet/preflight/mutation gate), src/harness/SelfImproveCompoundLoop.ts, CompoundRunEnvelope timeout taxonomy (single writer with classifyTimeoutError). ONE coherent patch + runFocusedTests or typeCheck. No speculative refactors. No beauty/artifacts.

W1-H1 REQUEUE: Sol failed (build+test invoked, no verified-edit). Fix exactly one real lint class in a scoped src/ or scripts/ set — prefer eslint-rules/ or a file with clear lint debt. Must land applyEdit/writeFile, re-run lint or focused tests, leave no style-only churn. If no lint debt found, fix one weak assertion (toBeDefined-only) in a related test — still a verified edit.
Add one guarded unit test for an existing pure helper; assert a concrete expected value (no toBeDefined-only).
Leg 1e: runtime was suspended at 20 steps — can the harness resume cleanly without duplicating edits or losing ledger correlation?
